title: A balancing tail?
hook: A lever model can test a limited balance idea.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The equal weights lie the same distance on opposite sides of the pivot in the balanced toy case. This is a lever illustration, not a measurement of dinosaur posture, muscle activity or balance.

misconception: Equal weights balance at arbitrary distances from a pivot.
objective: In this toy balance, one weight sits two units to the left of a pivot. Where can an equal weight balance it?

claims.text: A lever model can test a limited balance idea. In this toy balance, one weight sits two units to the left of a pivot. Where can an equal weight balance it? The equal weights lie the same distance on opposite sides of the pivot in the balanced toy case. This is a lever illustration, not a measurement of dinosaur posture, muscle activity or balance.
